about_the_game:
The SURANGAMA Combat Demo showcases a proof of concept for the full game. This demo is intended to gain feedback to make sure that SURANGAMA's combat experience and core mechanics are meeting player expectations as we continue development. Featuring 2 distinct map areas, several puzzles, 3 enemy types, and a harrowing boss battle this demo will give you a good idea of our intentions for the full title. 

This is an early, pre-alpha proof of concept build of SURANGAMA. As such, all art, audio, music, and mechanics should be considered Work in Progress and subject to change. 

Take up Your Sword and Brave the Abyss of Diyu!

Waking up on the ash covered shores of a river of blood, Tse Li Li discovers she has been dragged by a vengeful spirit into a terrifying realm of darkness and penitence . With the guidance of a voice from within, Li Li is granted the power to protect herself and find a way home in the form of an ethereal jade sword. You must learn the truth locked in Li Li's heart, help other lost souls find their way, and discover how and why Li Li is able to wander in this realm. No secrets stay buried forever...

content_descriptors.notes: SURANGAMA contains gore, horror, and disturbing imagery.

short_description: Unravel the truth and secrets which bind Tse Li Li to her forgotten past. Battle through hordes of relentless malformed souls and solve intricate puzzles in this Survival Horror X Character Action mashup set in a neon soaked Diyu, the Chinese-Buddhist vision of Hell, inspired by Kowloon Walled City.
